thread:
maya: Quick sync — pricing migration timeline: canary deploy planned Tue 9am PST. Any blockers from metering/billing/quotas/contracts? Need owners for rollback circuit breakers. 

alex: tagging owners: @kevin for billing, @jen for infra feature flag, @sasha for contract constraints. I can take mapping for rateplans. 

kevin: billing: short answer: one blocker. Grandfathered customers with legacy contract IDs won't map to new rateplan ids without an adapter. We're missing a lookup table and a fallback rule. 

sasha: contract side: confirmed — contracts flagged 'legacy_price_lock' need explicit migration approval from legal. That affects ~120 customers. Can we isolate them via quota guards? 

jen: infra/ops: can add a circuit-breaker route based on header X-pricing-version. Quick config:
```
routes:
  - match: headers.X-pricing-version == "v2"
    circuit: pricing-migration
    action: block-if-quota-mismatch
```
I'll open a PR for the routing change, pinging reviewers. ETA EOD today. 

matt: infra: need to coordinate with Dedicated for autoscaling. If canary triggers fallback to v1, Dedicated pool must be able to accept burst. I can add a temporary capacity floor. Will share infra cost delta. 

kevin: billing: I can deliver the lookup table by tomorrow but need confirmation on fallback semantics: prefer 'serve old price' or 'reject and surface error to client'? 

sasha: product: prefer serve old price + telemetry event so CS can follow up. Also add flag to exclude 'legacy_price_lock' from auto-migration. 

alex: ok — summary: billing produces lookup table + fallback serve-old; jen adds route + circuit-breaker PR; matt sets capacity floor; sasha/legal creates opt-out list for 120 customers. Owners: kevin, jen, matt, sasha. 

billing-bot: billing-schema-check: 2/3 endpoints validated. missing: /v2/price-lookup -> schema mismatch (timestamp format). See https://ci.internal/redwood/billing/2187 

kevin: acked, will fix schema and push by noon. 

maya: thanks all. If any blockers surface after the PRs, ping #eng-sre and @page oncall. Will post a final readiness checklist tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
